from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentExtraction(BaseModel):
    """Extracted legal data from a single judgment document."""
    document_id: str = Field(description="Identifier of the document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    case_type: str = Field(description="General type of case based on document title (e.g., 'Criminal', 'Civil', 'Administrative', 'Compensation')")
    
    criminal_charges: list[str] = Field(description="Specific criminal charges identified (e.g., '危险驾驶罪', '受贿罪', '交通肇事罪')")
    civil_disputes: list[str] = Field(description="Specific civil causes of action or dispute types (e.g., '所有权纠纷', '民间借贷纠纷', '共有物分割')")
    administrative_actions: list[str] = Field(description="Specific administrative actions or disputes (e.g., '行政处罚', '行政撤销', '吊销驾驶证')")
    compensation_nature: str | None = Field(description="Nature of compensation case if applicable (e.g., 'Criminal Compensation', 'Non-criminal Compensation', 'Error Execution Compensation')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentExtraction]
